Akıntı, geminin pruvasına bakmaksızın ye.en: Current is the movement of the body of water that affects the ship's movement over the ground regardless of its heading. 'Set' is the direction the current sets TOWARDS, not where it comes from (000°–360° T); 'drift' is the rate of the current (knots). With a current, the heading and the actual track over the ground (COG/track) differ. The CTS (Course To Steer) calculation finds, with vectors, which way the heading must point to keep the required track. Method: solve the track vector (track angle, distance to be made good in the planned time), the current vector (set, drift × time) and the ship's vector through the water (CTS, STW × time) in a vector triangle.

Büyük daire (great circle), Dünya merkez.en: A great circle is the circle formed on the Earth's surface by a plane passing through the Earth's centre, and it gives the shortest distance between two points. A rhumb line (loxodrome), on the other hand, is a constant-course curve that cuts all meridians at the same angle; on a Mercator chart it is a straight line, while on the sphere it is a logarithmic spiral that approaches the pole. The great-circle distance is always shorter than or equal to the rhumb-line distance (they are equal only along the equator and along a meridian). In practice a composite great circle, or dividing the great circle into rhumb-line segments (with waypoints), is preferred, because a pure great circle requires a course change at every point.

Büyük daire başlangıç kursu, geminin baş.en: The initial great-circle course is the true direction at the moment the ship joins the great-circle track from its starting position. Because the course is not constant along a great-circle track, the value calculated in practical navigation applies only at the start. The course changes as the passage progresses because the great-circle arc cuts the meridians at different angles.

Chapter II ve III – Güverte ve makine ye.en: Chapters II and III – deck and engine competences: Chapter II defines the competences of the bridge hierarchy step by step: the officer of the watch (OOW) must be able to carry out navigation, cargo and ship operations at the operational level; the chief mate and master must also cover passage planning, stability, damage control, legal obligations and crisis management at the management level. Chapter III applies the same logic to the engine department: competences in machinery operation, electrical/electronic systems, maintenance and management of ship systems are defined for the engineer officer of the watch, the second engineer and the chief engineer. The Electro-Technical Officer (ETO), a separate category, was formalised by the Manila amendments in response to the growing automation and electronic complexity of modern ships. These chapters also set the minimum sea service and approved training/assessment requirements for each level. On board, this means matching the general text to the ship's approved arrangement and real operating limits.

Chapter V ve VI – Özel ve zorunlu emniye.en: Chapters V and VI – special and mandatory safety training: Chapter V makes additional training mandatory for certain ship types: basic and advanced oil/chemical/gas tanker training for tanker personnel, IGF Code training for gas-fuelled ships, Polar Code training for navigation in polar waters, and crowd management and crisis management training for passenger ship personnel. Chapter VI sets the common safety and security training for all seafarers: Basic Safety Training (BST – fire prevention and firefighting, personal survival techniques, first aid, personal safety and social responsibilities), proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats (PSCRB), advanced firefighting, medical first aid/medical care, and security awareness and designated security duties training under ISPS. This training forms the invisible but vital base of the certificate. On board, this means matching the general text to the ship's approved arrangement and real operating limits.

Chapter VIII – Vardiya, dinlenme ve göre.en: Chapter VIII – watchkeeping, rest and fitness for duty: Chapter VIII treats fatigue as an explicit safety risk and regulates how both bridge and engine room watches are kept. The minimum hours of rest are firm: at least 10 hours of rest in any 24-hour period and at least 77 hours in any 7-day period; rest may be divided into no more than two periods, one of which must be at least 6 hours long. These hours are recorded and frequently examined in port State control. The 'fitness for duty' principle also covers the alcohol and drug policy; STCW sets a standard maximum alcohol limit for watchkeepers (0.05% BAC or 0.25 mg/L in breath). The chapter also defines watch handover, keeping a lookout and the bridge/engine room watch arrangements; these rules coincide directly with the lookout requirements of COLREG and with the ship's ISM safety management system. On board, this means matching the general text to the ship's approved arrangement and real operating limits.

Deniz suyu 55-70 bar basınçla yarı geçir.en: Seawater is pressed against a semi-permeable membrane at 55-70 bar. As the water molecules pass through the membrane, salts and minerals stay behind. Two flows are formed: permeate (product water) and concentrate (reject).

Deniz suyu devresi (sea water), merkezi.en: The seawater circuit rejects heat to the sea in the central cooler. On the fresh water side there are two circuits: the high-temperature (HT) circuit cools the cylinder liners/covers; the low-temperature (LT) circuit cools the oil cooler, the charge air cooler and the auxiliaries. Using fresh water reduces corrosion and salt deposits.

Deniz suyu giriş sıcaklığı kondenserin p.en: Seawater inlet temperature directly affects condenser performance. Capacity drops in tropical waters (32°C).

Deniz suyu ile doğrudan temas eden ekipm.en: Corrosion risk is reduced by reducing the number of items of equipment in direct contact with seawater. Cooling water quality is kept under control by chemical treatment.

Deniz yakıtlarında yoğunluk 15°C referan.en: For marine fuels, density is expressed in kg/m³ at the reference temperature of 15°C. It is measured with a hydrometer or a digital density meter.

Denizde çatışmayı önleme kurallarının ta.en: The history of the rules for preventing collisions at sea goes back to the Trinity House regulations of the 1840s. The present COLREG, adopted in 1972, made TSS (Traffic Separation Schemes) mandatory internationally for the first time. It consists of 41 rules and 4 annexes.

Designated Person Ashore, gemi ile en üs.en: The Designated Person Ashore provides access between the ship and the highest level of management and monitors safety and pollution prevention performance; they do not replace the master to run the ship's operation remotely. The master's overriding authority is the authority to take the decisions needed to protect life, the ship and the environment and to request the company's assistance. This authority is not an unplanned or unjustified departure but the institutional guarantee of the priority of safety.

Desludge aralığı zamana veya sludge mikt.en: The desludging interval is set by time or by the amount of sludge. In modern systems a water sensor detects sludge build-up and desludges at the optimum time.

Devir-teslim, Engine Log Book'a kaydedil.en: The handover is recorded in the Engine Log Book and signed by both engineers.

Devre elemanları sırası: sump tank → ana.en: Order of components in the circuit: sump tank → main LO pump (engine-driven + electric standby) → LO cooler (with the LT circuit) → full-flow filter → distribution to the engine. The oil is cleaned by a purifier in a continuous bypass flow.

Devrede pompa, tank, basınç emniyet valf.en: The circuit has a pump, tank, pressure relief valve, directional control valve (e.g. 4/3), flow control valve, check valve and actuator (cylinder/motor). Flow goes from the pump to the directional valve and from there to the actuator; the relief valve limits system pressure; the return line passes through the tank filter. Dashed lines show pilot/control lines.

Dezavantajı yüksek basınç ve sıcaklık sı.en: The disadvantage is the limit on pressure and temperature (usually < 25 bar, < 250°C).

The BCSN, the TML/moisture certificate, the representativeness of samples, rain, ventilation, gas/temperature and bilge measures are read together. 'We have carried it before' does not replace the current cargo documents.

Doğrultulmuş DC gerilimi düzleştirmek iç.en: A capacitor (capacitive) or choke (inductive) filter is used to smooth the rectified DC voltage.

Dünya 24 saatte 360° döndüğü için zaman.en: Since the Earth turns through 360° in 24 hours, time can be converted directly into angle. There is no trigonometry at this stage; only a fixed conversion is used.

Düşük yüklerde sıkıştırma sonu sıcaklığı.en: At low loads the temperature and pressure at the end of compression fall. VIT advances the injection timing so that combustion takes place around TDC.

Düzenlemenin temel mantığı uluslararası.en: The basic logic of the regulation is to make the international minimum standard common through flag State implementation, ship certification and port State control. Compliance is therefore not just obtaining a document; it is design, equipment, procedures, human competence, records and independent verification all giving the same result.

Düzenli yağ analizi (gemide spot/blotter.en: Regular oil analysis (spot/blotter test on board + laboratory) follows the trends of viscosity, TBN, water and metal particles (PQ index); deviations are early signs of failure.

Düzlem seyir (plane sailing), kısa mesaf.en: Plane sailing is the most basic navigational calculation method, based on the assumption that the Earth's surface can be treated as flat over short distances. In this approach the meridians are taken as parallel and the minutes of longitude as being of constant length, and the passage is solved as a right-angled triangle whose sides are DLat (difference of latitude, north–south component) and Dep (departure, east–west component) and whose hypotenuse is the total distance (Dist). Plane sailing is used only up to about 600 nm (even on legs of about 600 nm, as long as the difference of latitude does not exceed 4–5°) and in middle latitudes; on long east–west legs or in high latitudes, Mercator/mid-latitude sailing must be used instead.

Düzlem seyir sonucu yalnızca ölü hesap (.en: A plane sailing result is acceptable only for dead reckoning (DR); when a position fix is needed, verify it with a GPS/celestial fix.

GNSS, radar, echo sounder, gyro, speed log, AIS and visual/radar positions are used to check each other. EGR (Exhaust Gas Recirculation): Egzoz g.en: EGR (Exhaust Gas Recirculation): lowers the combustion temperature by mixing part of the exhaust gas into the intake air.

Egzoz ekonomizeri: Egzoz gazı ısısıyla b.en: Exhaust gas economiser: produces steam from exhaust gas heat. The simplest form of WHRS.

Egzoz gazı 200-350°C sıcaklıkta ekonomiz.en: Exhaust gas at 200-350°C passes over the economiser tubes and heats the water. This reduces the fuel consumption of the auxiliary boiler.

Egzoz gazı ekonomizerinde üretilen buhar.en: Steam produced in the exhaust gas economiser is led to a steam turbine-generator set to generate electricity. This arrangement is common especially on ships with large low-speed two-stroke engines.

Egzoz gazı scrubber kulesi içinde alkali.en: The exhaust gas is brought into contact with an alkaline solution in the scrubber tower. Sulphur compounds are neutralised by the reaction SO₂ + H₂O + NaOH → Na₂SO₃.

Egzoz gazının %20-40'ı soğutulup temizle.en: 20-40% of the exhaust gas is cooled, cleaned and returned to the intake manifold. Because CO₂ and water vapour have a high heat capacity, this lowers the combustion temperature.

Egzoz gazının yüksek sıcaklığı önemli bi.en: The high temperature of exhaust gas is an important source of exergy. Part of this exergy is recovered with an economiser or WHRS. The heat in the cooling water discharged overboard, on the other hand, is largely anergy because of the small temperature difference.

Egzoz gazları türbin çarkını döndürür, a.en: The exhaust gases turn the turbine wheel, and the compressor wheel on the same shaft compresses the intake air. The turbine wheel speed is 10000-30000 rpm.

The emergency generator or transitional emergency source must be able to supply the specified essential consumers for the required time. Besides lighting, the list includes functions that are critical for the ship, such as communications, alarms, navigation, the fire pump or steering.

Elektro-hidrolik veya elektrikli tahrik..en: Electro-hydraulic or electric drive. A warping drum and a rope drum are fitted together.

Elektronik governor (EG) mekanik tiplere.en: An electronic governor (EG) responds more precisely and faster than mechanical types.

Elektronik kontrollü motorlarda (ME) ECU.en: On electronically controlled engines (ME) the ECU balances the load automatically. The fuel index of each cylinder is adjusted independently.

Elektronik VIT (ME motorları): ECU taraf.en: Electronic VIT (ME engines): injection timing controlled by the ECU. Each cylinder can be adjusted independently.

Elektrot ile iş parçası arasında oluşan.en: The electric arc between the electrode and the workpiece melts both metals. The electrode coating melts and forms a shielding gas and slag that protect the weld pool from the atmosphere.

Emme ve basma valfleri kompresör verimin.en: The suction and delivery valves directly affect compressor efficiency. Cracks or wear in the valve plate, or damage to the seat, reduce performance.

Emme zamanında silindire yalnızca hava a.en: Only air is drawn into the cylinder on the intake stroke. At the end of compression the air temperature reaches 700-900°C, and fuel injected at this temperature ignites by itself.

Emniyet sertifikasının, gemide bulunması.en: The supplement to a safety certificate showing the details of the approved equipment that must be on board.

ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival), kalan m.en: ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) is the estimated time at which the ship will be at its destination, found by dividing the remaining distance by the average speed over the ground (SOG). An accurate ETA is a critical operational input for the berthing time slot, arranging the pilot and tugs, the watch plan and managing fuel consumption. SOG changes continuously because of current, weather, shallow water (squat), traffic and speed adjustments; the ETA must therefore be updated continuously, and an 'ETA Update' message must be sent to the agent/charterer when it changes significantly.

Her bölmede sintine kuyusu (bilge well).en: Each compartment has a bilge well. The bilge system consists of the bilge main, branch pipes, non-return valves and suction strainers. Dedicated centrifugal or reciprocating pumps are used as bilge pumps.

A power-driven vessel shall have her engines ready for immediate manoeuvre. An extra lookout, hand steering, suitable range/sea-rain clutter settings on both radars, fog signals and the master's presence on the bridge are decided by company procedure and the risk.

Her gemi tipi için referans çizgisi ve b.en: A reference line and band limits are defined for each ship type. The ship's annual CII value is rated against these bands.

Her gemiadamının yaptığı görev; geçerli.en: Every post a seafarer fills must be covered by a valid certificate of competency, flag recognition/endorsement, a medical certificate and, where required, training for the specific ship/operation.

Her gerekliliğin gemide görünür bir sahi.en: Every requirement must have a visible owner and evidence on board.

Her görüş koşulunda uygun görsel/işitsel.en: In every visibility condition a proper visual/aural lookout must be kept and the situation assessed with all available means; speed must be safe enough for the risk to be understood in time and for effective avoiding action.

Her kademede hava sıkıştırılır ve ara so.en: At each stage the air is compressed and then passed through an intercooler to lower its temperature. This reduces the compression work in the next stage and increases efficiency.

Her kapsam cümlesi geminin certificate p.en: Each scope statement is verified against the ship's certificate particulars, plans, equipment arrangement and operation. If there is an exemption, equivalent or grandfathering, the written authorisation, conditions and duration are shown; company habit does not create an exception to the scope.

Her kayıt: Tarih, operasyon kodu, tank/e.en: Each entry: date, operation code, tank/equipment details, quantity, signature.

Her kontrolcü bağımsız çalışabilir; merk.en: Each controller can work independently; local control continues even if the central station goes down.

Her konu için önce 'Bu hüküm neden bu ge.en: For every topic, first answer the question 'Why does this provision apply to this ship?'. Then explain the hazard the rule protects against and the safety function expected. In the third step show the actual equipment/procedure on board and the responsible roles, in the fourth the objective evidence produced, and in the fifth the safe state and reporting route in the event of a failure or deviation.

Her kritik hedefte CPA/TCPA değerinin ya.en: For every critical target, the reliability of the trend, the sensor mode and the time of the last manoeuvre should be shared within the bridge team as well as the CPA/TCPA value.

Her motorun running hour sayacı bulunur..en: Every engine has a running hour counter. The PMS software tracks running hours automatically and warns when a maintenance threshold is approaching.

Her muster station için kişi, kapasite,.en: For each muster station, persons, capacity, equipment, alternative route and the officer in charge should be matched, and a walk-through should be made with the real obstacles on board.

Her operasyon öncesi plan yapın.en: Make a plan before every operation

Her silindirin indike gücü indikatör diy.en: The indicated power of each cylinder is calculated from the indicator diagram. For cylinders that deviate from the mean, the fuel quantity (fuel rack) is adjusted.

Her transfer için gemi/tesis sorumluluğu.en: For every transfer, ship/facility responsibility, the stop criteria and the recovery plan for a person overboard must be confirmed at a joint toolbox meeting.

Her vardiya zabiti passage plan üzerinde.en: Every officer of the watch should be able to show on the ECDIS/chart the three most critical risks in the passage plan, the safety margin used and the criterion for calling the master.

Her yakıt ve yağ tankı çıkışında hızlı k.en: A quick-closing valve is fitted at the outlet of every fuel and oil tank. The valves can be closed remotely from outside the engine room (usually from an A-class deck level), pneumatically or mechanically (wire pull).

HFO operasyonunda sülfür ve kül kaynaklı.en: With HFO the effects of sulphur and ash are more marked: acid dew point corrosion, soot build-up and fouling of the heat transfer surfaces can develop faster. The outlet temperature and the cleaning interval are therefore managed more conservatively.

HFO sıcak ve viskoz, MGO ise soğuk ve dü.en: HFO is hot and viscous, MGO cold and of low viscosity. During changeover the fuel temperature is changed at a controlled rate (usually limited to a few degrees per minute); a sudden change leads to scuffing and leaks in the fuel pumps/injectors. If the viscosity of the MGO is very low, cooling (a chiller) may be needed. The changeover is started well before the ECA boundary and recorded with time and position.

HFO yoğunluğu tipik olarak 960-991 kg/m³.en: HFO density is typically 960-991 kg/m³ and MGO density 830-890 kg/m³.

HFO, enjeksiyon için belirli bir viskozi.en: HFO must be brought to a set viscosity for injection (usually ~10-15 cSt); this is done by a viscosity-controlled heater (viscotherm). Low/high level alarms and quick-closing valves are fitted on the service tank for fire safety.

Hız azaltma kararı, radar menzilinde hed.en: The decision to reduce speed must not wait until a target is seen within radar range. Detection range varies with the size of the target, rain/sea clutter, antenna height and shadow sectors. A small craft or ice may be detected much later than a large ship.

Hız azaltma/stop, güvenli tarafta koordi.en: Options including reducing speed/stopping, a coordinated manoeuvre to the safe side, early sound/light warnings and calling the master are considered; the necessary departure is made clearly and traceably, and normal navigation is resumed once the danger has passed.

Hız değişimiyle karşılaşma periyodunu ka.en: Shift the encounter period by changing speed

Hız ve emniyet marjı artırılmalı, kaptan.en: Speed should be reduced and the safety margin increased, the master called and independent visual/radar/echo-sounder checks made; the ship must not continue into narrow water on an unverified position.

Hızlı sıcaklık değişimi yakıt pompası ve.en: A rapid temperature change can damage the seals of the fuel pump and injection system. The rate of temperature change should typically be no more than 2°C per minute.

Hızlı ve dengesiz operasyonlar tehlikeli.en: Rapid and unbalanced operations are dangerous

A permit to work alone does not provide safety; isolation, gas measurement, draining, a fire sentry, checks of adjacent spaces and a fire watch after the job must be verified on site.

II-1 bir hasarın gemiyi kaybetmeye dönüş.en: II-1 sets up the structural and technical barriers that stop damage from turning into the loss of the ship. Watertight integrity, the bilge system, propulsion and steering, and the main and emergency sources of electrical power are different layers of defence against the same loss scenario.

II-1'in amacı tek arızayı kontrol edileb.en: The purpose of II-1 is to keep a single failure under control.

II-2'nin hedefe dayalı yapısı yangının v.en: The goal-based structure of II-2 aims to prevent fire and explosion, reduce the risk to life, contain the fire in the space of origin, protect the means of escape, and provide access and readiness for firefighting. A-class divisions, fire doors, insulation, detectors, sprinklers, fixed gas systems and the fire main are not alternatives to each other but successive defences.

Neden gerekli: insan faktörü ve standard.en: Why it is needed: the human factor and standardisation: STCW grew out of the fact that most accidents at sea are caused by people. Before the convention each country applied its own standard of competence; a master's certificate valid in one country could be considered inadequate under another flag. STCW resolves this chaos by placing the training, certification and watchkeeping standards of seafarers on an international minimum base. It has two layers: the Convention text containing the mandatory provisions, and the STCW Code giving the technical details. The Code is in turn divided into the binding Part A and the recommendatory Part B. In this way 'competence' stops being an abstract idea and is reduced to measurable tables of knowledge, skills and attitudes (competence tables). On board, this means matching the general text to the ship's approved arrangement and real operating limits.

Pusula düzeltme, pusuladan okunan rota i.en: Compass correction is the conversion between the course read from the compass and the true course actually made good. A magnetic compass has two error components: variation (V) — the angle between the Earth's magnetic field and geographic north (shown on the chart's compass rose, with an annual change); and deviation (D) — the deflection of the compass needle by the ship's own magnetic field (steel hull, machinery), read from the deviation card for the ship's heading. The two corrections are applied with the CDMVT mnemonic: Compass → Deviation → Magnetic → Variation → True. Easterly errors are added and westerly errors subtracted (in the Compass → True direction).

Rule 10 mümkün olduğunca dik heading ist.en: Rule 10 requires a heading as nearly as practicable at right angles, but safe navigation and the other rules still apply. Correcting only the ground track on the screen may make the ship's intention unclear to other ships.

Rule 13 overtaking, başka gemiye kıç doğ.en: Rule 13 overtaking starts with the definition of coming up with another vessel from a direction more than 22.5 degrees abaft her beam. If there is any doubt, she shall assume she is overtaking. The overtaking vessel keeps her responsibility until she is finally past and clear, even if the bearing later changes and it looks like a crossing.

Rule 14'te iki power-driven vessel recip.en: Under Rule 14, when two power-driven vessels are meeting on reciprocal or nearly reciprocal courses so as to involve risk, each alters course to starboard. If there is any doubt, she shall assume a head-on situation exists. Under Rule 15, in a crossing situation the power-driven vessel that has the other on her own starboard side is the give-way vessel and shall, if the circumstances admit, avoid crossing ahead of the other.

Rule 17'nin may/must aşamaları, mevcut m.en: The may/must stages of Rule 17, the current distance/time, the other ship's action and the last manoeuvre needed to avoid collision must be explained.

Rule 18, Rules 9, 10 ve 13 ile birlikte.en: Rule 18 is read together with Rules 9, 10 and 13.

Rule 18, Rules 9, 10 ve 13'te aksi gerek.en: Rule 18 sets the responsibilities between power-driven, sailing, fishing, NUC, RAM and CBD vessels except where Rules 9, 10 and 13 otherwise require. The overtaking rule comes before the relationship between vessel types; the not-to-impede provisions in narrow channels and TSSs also change the general scheme. A single memorised pyramid therefore does not solve every encounter.

Rule 2'yi istenen manevrayı meşrulaştıra.en: Seeing Rule 2 as a free clause that justifies any desired manoeuvre

Rule 35, restricted visibility içinde ve.en: Under Rule 35, in or near an area of restricted visibility a vessel gives periodic sound signals according to her status and movement. The signals for a power-driven vessel making way and for one underway but stopped and making no way are different; vessels such as NUC, RAM, CBD, sailing, fishing and towing vessels use their own patterns. There are bell/gong and additional signals for vessels at anchor and aground.

Rule 36, başka geminin dikkatini çekmek.en: Rule 36 allows a vessel to make light or sound signals that cannot be mistaken for any signal authorised in the rules to attract the attention of another vessel; dazzling the other ship with a high-intensity searchlight is not appropriate. Using a laser or deck lights must not endanger the lookout either.

Rule 37 ve Annex IV distress ve yardım i.en: Rule 37 and Annex IV list the signals that indicate distress and need of assistance. DSC distress alerts, EPIRBs, MAYDAY, rockets/flares, orange smoke and other recognised signals are used according to the situation and equipment. A false distress signal can have serious legal and operational consequences; test procedures must prevent a real alert.

Rules 20-31 ışıkların sunset-sunrise ara.en: Rules 20-31 require lights to be shown from sunset to sunrise and in other conditions where necessary, including restricted visibility, and prohibit other lights that could be mistaken for them. Shapes are shown by day. Deck working lights, advertising/service lights or accommodation lights must not impair the visibility/character of the COLREG lights.

Changes of section raise the stress by Kt (the stress concentration factor); this is reduced by using rounded transitions (fillets) instead of sharp corners.

Visibility, traffic density, the manoeuvrability of the ship, background light at night, wind, sea and current, navigational hazards and draught/depth of water are assessed. Ships with radar also take into account the characteristics of the radar, range scale limitations, sea/rain clutter, the detection of small targets and the number of targets.

Sertifika güvenilirliği: değerlendirme,.en: Reliability of certificates: assessment, revalidation and oversight: the strength of STCW comes from certificates being genuinely reliable, so the convention regulates not only training but also the quality control of training. Competence is proven through approved simulators (ECDIS, ARPA, engine room), structured onboard training records (training record book) and standardised assessments. Certificates are not open-ended: typically every five years they must be revalidated through sufficient sea service or an approved refresher course; tanker endorsements and safety training in particular are refreshed at set intervals. To protect the integrity of the system, IMO keeps the countries that comply effectively with the requirements on a 'white list'; a seafarer's certificate must also be recognised by an endorsement from the flag of the ship employing them. The use of fraudulent certificates is prosecuted severely, and discrepancies in certificates/rest records in port State control can lead to the detention of the ship. On board, this means matching the general text to the ship's approved arrangement and real operating limits.

Sertifika mevcutsa fiziksel arızanın den.en: Thinking that a physical defect does not matter for an inspection as long as the certificate is on board

Sertifika operasyon limitini görünür kıl.en: The certificate makes the operating limit visible; it is not the limit itself.

Sertifika üzerindeki gemi bilgilerini ve.en: Cross-check the ship details on the certificate and its supplements against the actual equipment

Sertifika, onaylı konfigürasyon ve gemid.en: The certificate, the approved configuration and the actual condition on board must be the same.

Sertifikadaki kişi/operasyon limitini ti.en: Confusing the person/operation limit on the certificate with the commercial capacity calculation

Sertifikasyon mimarisi ve eğitim basamak.en: Certification architecture and levels of training: every seafarer holds a Certificate of Competency (CoC) appropriate to their post and an endorsement from the flag State recognising it. The common base for everyone is Basic Safety Training (fire, survival, first aid, personal safety). Post-specific training is added on top: ARPA, ECDIS and Bridge Resource Management for deck officers; the engine room simulator for engineer officers; oil/chemical/gas endorsements for tanker personnel. Passenger ship personnel receive crowd and crisis management training. Competence must be maintained: typically every five years it has to be revalidated, either through sufficient sea service or an approved refresher course. On board, this means matching the general text to the ship's approved arrangement and real operating limits.

Servis raporu açık bulgularıyla birlikte.en: A service report is managed together with its open findings.

SOLAS teknik donanımı yönetim ve güvenli.en: SOLAS connects technical equipment to the management and security systems. A working piece of equipment on board is not a lasting barrier unless there is responsibility, procedure, reporting and a learning mechanism to sustain it.

The same trade name may need different documents and ship suitability when carried in a different form.

SOLAS XI-2 ve ISPS Code; gemi, şirket ve.en: SOLAS XI-2 and the ISPS Code set up security risk assessment, plans, duties, communications and security levels between the ship, the company and the port facility. Access to the plan is controlled; confidentiality does not mean the crew may not know their own duties.

SOLAS XIV, Polar Code'un emniyet bölümün.en: SOLAS XIV makes the safety part of the Polar Code mandatory. SOLAS, ana sevkin tek bir ekipman arızas.en: SOLAS requires auxiliary systems, alarms, remote control and, for some functions, redundancy to stop a single equipment failure in the main propulsion from becoming an uncontrolled danger. Automatic systems do not make knowledge of the local station and manual intervention unnecessary.

The 1974 SOLAS Convention in force today is kept up to date continuously through the 'tacit acceptance' procedure. The 2024 consolidated edition covers 14 chapters and many codes.

For example, if the TCE is 18,000/day and time charters in the market pay 15,000/day, the voyage charter looks commercially more attractive. The buoy system is interpreted according.en: The buoyage system is read according to the IALA scheme, and the world is divided into two main regions. Region A covers Europe, Africa, most of Asia and Australia — Türkiye is in Region A: when entering harbour, red marks are kept to port and green marks to starboard. Region B covers North and South America, Japan, Korea and the Philippines, and the lateral colours are REVERSED: when entering harbour, red is kept to starboard and green to port ('red right returning', as American seafarers memorise it). The critical point is that this is not a statement about colour but a passing instruction. Because the same colour can mean different sides in different regions, the first reflex on seeing a buoy symbol on the chart must be to ask 'which IALA region am I in?'. Although the region changes, the shape does not: the port-hand mark is cylindrical (can) in both regions and the starboard-hand mark is conical in both; when the colour cannot be read, the shape and topmark still give correct information. The chart often shows the buoy as a dot, but that dot marks the edge of a channel, the side on which to pass a danger, or confirmation of the approach line; the purpose of the symbol is therefore not just to inform but to guide action.

Tidal tables give each day's High Water.en: Tide tables give each day's High Water (HW) and Low Water (LW) times and heights for a particular reference port (standard port), usually in UT (UTC) and in metres relative to chart datum. The Admiralty Tide Tables (ATT), the publications of the Office of Navigation, Hydrography and Oceanography for Türkiye and the tables of local administrations are among the main sources. Tide tables are organised in two basic structures: (1) Standard ports: full annual HW/LW times and heights are given in tabular form. (2) Secondary/subordinate ports: time and height correction factors are given relative to a standard reference port; these factors are applied to the standard port's tables and the calculation is made for the secondary port.

Under-Keel Clearance (UKC), geminin omur.en: Under-Keel Clearance (UKC) is the instantaneous free depth between the ship's keel and the seabed. Many flag administrations and company SMSs require a minimum UKC policy. Squat — the dynamic sinkage that increases rapidly in shallow and narrow waters — is a critical danger; the Barrass formula is the estimate most widely used in practice.

Yeterlilik tabloları, fonksiyonlar ve se.en: Competence tables, functions and levels: the technical heart of the STCW Code is the competence tables that make competence measurable. For each task, tables are defined with the columns 'competence – knowledge/understanding/proficiency – methods for demonstrating competence – criteria for evaluating competence'; in this way 'a good officer of the watch' stops being an abstract quality and is reduced to competences that can be counted and tested. The convention divides duties into seven functions (navigation, cargo handling, controlling the operation of the ship/care for persons on board, marine engineering, electrical engineering, maintenance and repair, radiocommunications) and treats each function at three levels of responsibility: operational (officer of the watch), management (master/chief engineer and chief mate/second engineer) and support (ratings). A person's certificate shows at which level they are competent in which function; this structure creates a consistent language of competence worldwide. On board, this means matching the general text to the ship's approved arrangement and real operating limits.

Mercator projeksiyonu, küresel Dünya yüz.en: The Mercator projection is based on developing the spherical surface of the Earth onto a cylinder, and it is the basis of rhumb line (loxodrome) sailing. Meridians are shown as vertical lines parallel to one another, and parallels of latitude as horizontal lines. As latitude increases the distance between the parallels grows, tending to infinity towards the poles. This deliberate distortion makes a constant-course track a straight line on the chart.

Mercator seyri, Mercator projeksiyonunun.en: Mercator sailing is a constant-course (loxodrome) sailing method that uses the mathematical structure of the Mercator projection. It removes the error that plane sailing produces as latitude increases by expressing latitude in 'meridional parts' (MP — enlarged latitude), which are in the same units as minutes of longitude. On the Mercator projection the meridians are parallel and the intervals of latitude are stretched proportionally towards the poles; a constant course therefore becomes a straight line on the chart, and the course angle can be measured directly from it. It is the standard method for long east–west legs, in high latitudes and on ocean crossings.

In celestial navigation the azimuth is the only directional information that determines in which direction the intercept is laid off and in which direction the LOP is drawn. Sıcaklık, bir cismin termal enerji düzey.en: Temperature is an indicator of the thermal energy level of a body. The SI unit is the kelvin (K); its relation to Celsius (°C) is T(K) = t(°C) + 273.15.

Termodinamik hesaplamalarda mutlaka Kelv.en: The Kelvin scale must always be used in thermodynamic calculations. Although calculations made on the Celsius scale are valid for temperature differences, they cause errors in formulas involving ratios or multiplication.

Hacim, bir sistemin kapladığı uzay mikta.en: Volume is the amount of space a system occupies. Specific volume (v) is the volume occupied by unit mass and is the reciprocal of density.

v: Özgül hacim (m³/kg) · V: Toplam hacim.en: v: Specific volume (m³/kg) · V: Total volume (m³) · m: Mass (kg) · ρ: Density (kg/m³)

İç enerji, bir sistemin moleküler düzeyd.en: Internal energy is the total kinetic and potential energy of a system at molecular level. As temperature rises the kinetic energy of the molecules increases, and the internal energy therefore rises.

Kapalı bir sistemde birinci yasa gereği:.en: For a closed system the first law is written as Q - W = ΔU, where Q is the heat supplied to the system and W is the work done by the system.

ΔU: İç enerji değişimi (kJ) · m: Kütle (.en: ΔU: Change in internal energy (kJ) · m: Mass (kg) · cv: Specific heat at constant volume (kJ/kg·K) · ΔT: Change in temperature (K)

Entalpi, iç enerji ile basınç-hacim çarp.en: Enthalpy is the sum of the internal energy and the pressure–volume product: H = U + PV. In open systems it represents the total energy carried by the fluid.

Sabit basınçtaki süreçlerde sisteme veri.en: In constant-pressure processes the heat supplied to the system equals the change in enthalpy. This makes the analysis of shipboard equipment such as boilers, condensers and heat exchangers much easier.

ΔH: Entalpi değişimi (kJ) · cp: Sabit ba.en: ΔH: Change in enthalpy (kJ) · cp: Specific heat at constant pressure (kJ/kg·K)

Tek bir ısı kaynağından ısı alarak tamam.en: It is impossible to build a cyclic machine that takes heat from a single source and converts it entirely into work. In other words, every heat engine must reject heat to a low-temperature reservoir.

Bu ifade, hiçbir ısı makinesinin %100 te.en: This statement means that no heat engine can reach 100% thermal efficiency. All heat engines, including diesel engines, steam turbines and gas turbines, are subject to this limitation.

Dışarıdan iş verilmeden, düşük sıcaklıkt.en: It is impossible to build a machine that continuously transfers heat from a low-temperature reservoir to a high-temperature reservoir without work being supplied from outside.

Bu ifade soğutma makineleri ve ısı pompa.en: This statement sets the basic limitation for refrigerating machines and heat pumps: energy (electricity) must always be supplied from outside to the refrigeration or air-conditioning compressor.

Bilge tankında seviye şamandırası kontro.en: On an entry into the bilge tank to check the level sensor, the atmosphere was tested only at the manhole opening; the bottom and middle levels of the tank were not tested. A few minutes after entering, the first crew member suffered dizziness and loss of coordination.

Kurtarma refleksiyle ikinci personel, ta.en: Acting on a rescue reflex, a second crew member entered the tank without full equipment or a lifeline; the incident quickly turned into a near-miss with two casualties.

Permit to Work sürecinin prosedürel bir.en: The main root causes were that the Permit to Work process had become a procedural formality, that no multi-point atmosphere test was made, and that the role of the standby person was misunderstood as simply 'waiting'.

Ayrıca 'işi hızlı bitirme' baskısı neden.en: In addition, pressure to 'get the job done quickly' led to the ventilation time being cut short, and the toolbox talk before entry was not held in sufficient depth.

İkincil kök neden, kurtarma planının eki.en: A secondary root cause was that the rescue plan had not been rehearsed by the team; this is why unauthorised rescue behaviour appeared during the incident.

Kapalı alan girişinde O₂, H₂S, CO ve LEL.en: On entry into an enclosed space, O₂, H₂S, CO and LEL must be measured at the top, middle and bottom levels, and the results recorded on the permit form with the time in hours and minutes. Measurement is not a one-off; it must continue periodically throughout the entry.

Mekanik havalandırma yeterli süre çalışt.en: Mechanical ventilation must be run for a sufficient time; if the ventilation stops, the entry must be suspended automatically. A personal multi-gas detector must be kept switched on by everyone inside.

Giriş gözcüsü, iletişim hattı ve kurtarm.en: Entry must not start until an attendant at the entrance, a communication link and rescue equipment (SCBA, tripod, retrieval line) are ready. Rescue must be carried out only by a trained team; an unauthorised second entry is strictly forbidden.

SOLAS III/19.3.3 gereği en az iki ayda b.en: Under SOLAS III/19.3.3, a realistic enclosed space entry and rescue drill must be held at least every two months, and the measurement, communication and evacuation times reported.

Kapalı alan olaylarında ikinci kayıp çoğ.en: In enclosed space incidents the second casualty is often caused by the 'reflex to help'. The right reflex is not an unplanned entry but raising the alarm, isolating, and calling in the trained rescue team.

En güçlü önlem ekipman değil, prosedürü.en: The strongest safeguard is not the equipment but the behaviour of the team applying the procedure. Safety comes not from filling in the form but from putting what the form requires into practice on site.

AP merkezli soyut göksel üçgen pratikte.en: In practice the abstract celestial triangle centred on the AP is solved with the Sight Reduction Tables (HO-249/HO-229). For the given φ, δ and LHA the tables give the Hc (calculated altitude) and Zn (azimuth) values directly. No trigonometry is done at this stage; Zn is a value read from the tables.

Azimut doğru hesaplanıp doğru yarımküred.en: Unless the azimuth is worked out correctly and laid off in the correct hemisphere, the position line will be plotted in the wrong position even if the intercept is correct. In celestial navigation the azimuth therefore calls for disciplined interpretation more than calculation.

Azimut hesabı her zaman varsayılan mevki.en: The azimuth is always worked out for the assumed position (AP). The information required is the declination of the body (δ), the observer's latitude (φ) and the local hour angle of the body (LHA). These three values are found from the Nautical Almanac and the time–arc relationship; nothing is plotted yet at this stage.

Bir gemi 37° N enleminden büyük daire se.en: Let a ship start a great circle passage from latitude 37° N with an initial course of 55°.

Bu sonuç, geminin büyük daire seyri boyu.en: This result shows that on the great circle passage the ship will not go above approximately latitude 49.1° N. If this value is above the acceptable limit in areas such as the North Atlantic in the winter season, the route should be revised using a composite or limiting-latitude approach.

Departure, harita üzerinde doğrudan ölçü.en: Departure is not a value measured directly on the chart; it is a calculated quantity. While the parallels of latitude on the chart represent DLat, departure represents the east–west movement across the meridians. However, because the spacing of the meridians changes with latitude, departure is not read directly from the longitude scale; it is calculated first and then used in the change-of-longitude calculations.

Eğer maksimum enlem riskli bölgelere gir.en: If the maximum latitude enters dangerous areas, the great circle route is not used as it stands; composite great circle or limiting-latitude planning is preferred.

Gök cisminin doğuda mı batıda mı olduğu.en: Whether the body is east or west of the meridian comes from the LHA. Using this, the azimuth angle read from the tables is laid off clockwise from true north.

İki mevki arasındaki D.Lat ve D.Long bul.en: The D.Lat and D.Long between the two positions are found

İkinci LOP, mevkii sağlar.en: The second LOP provides the position

LHA 180°’den büyük olduğu için gök cismi.en: Because LHA is greater than 180°, the body is east of the meridian. Zn is laid off as 118° clockwise from true north. On the chart a line of sight is drawn from the AP in the direction 118°. The LOP will be drawn perpendicular to this line.

Seyir üçgeninden Course ve Distance bulu.en: Course and Distance are found from the sailing triangle

Seyir üçgeninden D.Lat ve Departure bulu.en: D.Lat and Departure are found from the sailing triangle

Varsayılan mevki enlemi 36° N olsun. Gök.en: Let the assumed latitude be 36° N, the declination of the body 12° S and LHA = 300°. Using the Sight Reduction Tables, Zn = 118° is read for these values.

Vertex noktası, büyük daire yayının bir.en: The vertex is the position at which the great circle arc touches a parallel of latitude. At this point the rate of change of latitude momentarily falls to zero and the course comes closest to east–west.

Vertex, büyük daire rotasının kutba en y.en: The vertex is the point at which the great circle track is nearest to the pole. Because the great circle is the shortest route, it “curves up” towards higher latitudes; not knowing the limit of this curve can take the ship into unwanted meteorological and operational conditions.

Zn doğrultusu çizilir; bunun LOP’un kend.en: The Zn direction is drawn; it is specifically emphasised that this is not the LOP itself. The LOP is drawn perpendicular to Zn. This completes the job of the azimuth: Zn provides only a directional reference.

En pratik yaklaşım, başlangıç enlemi ve.en: The most practical approach is to find the vertex latitude from the initial latitude and the initial course. The absolute value gives the magnitude of the maximum latitude; its sign (N/S) is assessed from the hemisphere of the route and the direction of travel.

Quick decisions are critical at this stage, but wrong decisions taken in panic can make the situation worse.

Balast Tank Sıralaması ise trim ve stabi.en: Ballast tank sequencing, on the other hand, is a process managed actively to control trim and stability. When ballasting, the double bottom tanks are filled first (to increase stability), then the fore peak tank (to correct the trim) and finally the side tanks (for fine adjustment). When deballasting, the upper tanks are emptied first (GM increases), then the side tanks (heel control) and the double bottom tanks last (final stage).

Ballast Arrival (Balast Varış) durumu, u.en: The Ballast Arrival condition is the scenario in which the ship reaches the port of arrival with minimum fuel after a long ballast passage. It usually corresponds to the lowest displacement and can be the weakest point for stability. With minimum fuel the position of the centre of gravity changes and GM can approach critical values.

Ballast Departure (Balast Kalkış) durumu.en: The Ballast Departure condition is the scenario in which the ship sails with ballast water only and no cargo. Full ballast tanks keep the propeller sufficiently immersed and the forward draft at an acceptable level. In ballast the displacement is low and the ship's windage area is large, so the wind heeling moment becomes more critical. Because KM differs at low displacements, a separate stability assessment is required for ballast conditions.

Başlangıç kursu yaklaşık 039° gerçek kur.en: The initial course is about 039° true. As the passage proceeds this course changes, reaching its greatest difference at the intermediate points and ending at a different value towards the arrival.

Başlangıç mevkiine eklenerek varış mevki.en: Applying it to the departure position gives the arrival position

Başlangıç ve varış aynı yarımküredeyse f.en: If departure and arrival are in the same hemisphere, the difference is taken; if they are in different hemispheres, the absolute values are added and the result is named according to the direction of arrival. Example: going from 12°N to 5°S, DLat = 12° + 5° = 17° South. The same rule applies to longitude: going from 20°E to 10°W, DLong = 20° + 10° = 30° West.

Bir gemide aynı anda birden fazla kısmen.en: If a ship has several slack tanks at the same time, the total free surface effect is calculated from the total FSM.

Bir gök cisminin gök ekvatoruna göre açı.en: The angular distance of a celestial body from the celestial equator is expressed by its declination (δ), and its angular position relative to the local meridian by the hour angle (LHA). The observer's latitude is φ, and the altitude of the observed body above the horizon is h. These quantities define the sides and angles of the spherical triangle on the celestial sphere.

The pure great circle route would take the ship up to latitudes of 55–60° North. In the winter months this area is known for deep low-pressure systems and high seas. In this case the limiting latitude is set at 48° North.

However, if this property is not understood, intuitive errors can be made when reading the chart in high latitudes.

Bu nedenle düzlem seyir, genellikle yakl.en: For this reason plane sailing is usually preferred for passages of up to about 60 nautical miles. As the distance increases, the change of longitude has to be corrected according to latitude. This is where mean latitude sailing comes in.

Bu nokta, ikinci kerteriz anındaki gemi.en: This point is the ship's position at the time of the second bearing.

Bu örnek, Mercator projeksiyonunda kurs.en: This example clearly shows that on the Mercator projection course calculations are made using the isometric latitude and that Δλ must be taken in radians.

Bu örnekte büyük daire rotası yüksek enl.en: In this example the great circle route does not go into high latitudes. However, if φmax were, for example, 55° North and the operational limit were set at 50° North, a composite route would be used with 50° North as the limiting latitude.

Bu rota dümenlenirse, gemi 085°T’ye deği.en: If this course is steered, the ship makes good 090°T CMG, not 085°T.

Bu rota dümenlenirse, gemi 090°T CMG üze.en: If this course is steered, the ship proceeds on a CMG of 090°T.

Bu sınırlar bilinmeden yapılan her düzle.en: Any plane sailing calculation made without knowing these limits gives a wrong result even if the correct formulas are used. Mean latitude sailing is an intermediate method developed with these limits in mind.

Bu sonuç, geminin yerel öğle anında 8° 3.en: This result shows that at local noon the ship is in latitude 8° 30.0′ North. The noon position gives a quick and reliable latitude check in the open sea; but it is operationally weak in cloudy weather and when the Sun is not clearly seen at the meridian.

Bu yaklaşımda, seyir boyunca boylam daki.en: In this approach the length of a minute of longitude is taken as constant over the passage; but this constant value is related to the mean latitude of the track rather than to the equator. This reduces the main source of error in plane sailing.

Burada Δλ boylam farkı, Δψ izometrik enl.en: Here Δλ is the difference of longitude and Δψ the difference of isometric latitude. On the Mercator projection the isometric latitude is:

Burada ψ, Mercator enlemi; φ ise küresel.en: Here ψ is the Mercator latitude and φ the spherical latitude. This conversion represents the true positions of the parallels of latitude on the chart.

Büyük açılı stabilitede, pozitif stabili.en: In large-angle stability, the critical limit that determines the range of positive stability is often the downflooding angle. The GZ curve should therefore be assessed not only with its geometric zero point but together with the angle at which the ship starts to take in water.

Büyük daire ise küre üzerindeki en kısa.en: Although the great circle is the shortest path on the sphere, it appears as a curve on a Mercator chart; only the equator and the meridians appear as straight lines.

Büyük daire mesafesi düzlem trigonometri.en: Great circle distance cannot be calculated with plane trigonometry. Differences of latitude and longitude only have meaning within spherical trigonometry. The first step is therefore to find the central angle between the two positions correctly. The spherical cosine formula gives the central angle directly:

Büyük daire mesafesi, küre üzerindeki ik.en: The great circle distance is the shortest surface path joining two positions on the sphere. It is defined by the central angle seen at the centre of the Earth. As the central angle increases, the great circle arc lengthens in direct proportion.

Büyük daire seyrinde rota genellikle yük.en: In great circle sailing the route usually curves towards higher latitudes. This is not practical in winter conditions, in areas with an ice risk or where the ship's operational limits are stretched. A composite route gives a safer and more predictable alternative to the great circle: the ship joins the great circle, leaves it before reaching the limiting latitude, follows the parallel of that latitude, and rejoins a great circle at a suitable point.

Büyük daire teorik olarak iki mevki aras.en: In theory the great circle gives the shortest spherical path between two positions. On long ocean passages, however, this route often runs into high latitudes. High latitudes are commercially unattractive because of severe weather systems, ice risk, longer and higher seas and temperature-related operational limits. A pure great circle route is therefore rarely sailed.

Büyük daire, küre üzerinde iki mevki ara.en: The great circle gives the shortest surface distance between two positions on the sphere; the rhumb line (loxodrome) is the track that appears as a straight line on the Mercator projection and is followed on a constant course throughout. A rhumb line is easier to manage; a great circle usually gives a shorter distance. In practice the decision is made not on distance alone but together with weather, traffic, safety and operational constraints.

Büyük dairede kurs sürekli değişir; rhum.en: On a great circle the course changes continuously; on a rhumb line the course is constant. The great circle therefore offers an advantage in fuel and time, the rhumb line one of simplicity. Modern ECDIS and route planning systems divide the great circle into waypoints and sail it as rhumb line legs, giving a hybrid method in practice.

C, meridyene göre ölçülür.en: C is measured from the meridian

Clearing Line, klasik seyrüseferde fix s.en: In traditional navigation a clearing line does not give a fix, but it is one of the most important safety tools for guaranteeing that the ship stays clear of a danger.

CMG doğrultusunda 10 NM çizilir.en: 10 NM is laid off along the CMG

Composite rota, büyük daireye göre biraz.en: A composite route is somewhat longer than the great circle, but in terms of safety, track keeping and operational predictability it is a balanced solution in commercial shipping. It is standard practice especially on North Atlantic and North Pacific crossings.

cos Mean Lat, paralelin kısalmasını tems.en: cos Mean Lat represents the shortening of the parallel
