Course to Steer, klasik seyrüseferde akı.en: In traditional navigation, the course to steer is the basic method of finding the course by which the current is actually allowed for, keeping the ship on the intended track.

Cross Bearings ile Fix, klasik seyrüsefe.en: A fix by cross bearings gives a quick, visual and reliable position in traditional navigation; when used with suitable objects and simultaneous bearings it is one of the most accurate terrestrial fixing methods.

Çünkü LOP, objeden gemiye doğru çizilir.en: Because the LOP is drawn from the object towards the ship

Dead Reckoning ve Estimated Position, kl.en: Dead reckoning and the estimated position are basic position-fixing methods used at all times in traditional navigation; they keep the ship from being without a position even when no fix can be obtained.

Değerlendirme (5–15 dakika) aşamasında,.en: In the Assessment stage (5–15 minutes) the cause of the loss of stability is sought. There are three main possible causes: flooding, cargo shift or excessive free surface effect. Identifying the cause determines the corrective action to be taken.

Departure değeri daima deniz mili cinsin.en: Departure is always expressed in nautical miles, and its sign shows whether the ship is moving east or west. This directional information is used directly in course calculations and in the relationship with the change of longitude.

Departure kullanılarak D.Long hesaplanır.en: D.Long is calculated using the departure

Departure, geminin doğu–batı doğrultusun.en: Departure is the actual distance the ship covers in the east–west direction and is expressed in nautical miles. The change of longitude, on the other hand, is expressed in degrees and minutes. The two quantities are not directly equal; the conversion between them is made with the cosine of the latitude concerned.

Dik seyir üçgeninden Course ve Distance.en: Course and Distance are calculated from the right-angled sailing triangle

Distance Off by Horizontal Angle, klasik.en: Distance off by horizontal angle gives a range from a single measurement in traditional navigation and is effective especially in coastal waters with good visibility.

Distance Off by Vertical Angle, klasik s.en: Distance off by vertical angle gives a reliable range from a single measurement in traditional navigation and is especially important for coastal safety.

Dünya yüzeyi, küçük alan için düzlemsel.en: The Earth's surface is treated as flat over a small area

Düşey açı küçüldükçe mesafe artar.en: The smaller the vertical angle, the greater the distance

En az iki sabit obje gerekir.en: At least two fixed objects are needed

En az iki sabit obje seçilir.en: At least two fixed objects are chosen

Enlem arttıkça meridyenler birbirine yak.en: As latitude increases the meridians converge. Mean latitude sailing tries to allow for this convergence by using the mean latitude.

Enlemler aynı isimde alınır.en: The latitudes are taken with the same name

Enlemler aynı isimde olmalıdır.en: The latitudes must have the same name

Fix by Cross Bearings, klasik seyrüsefer.en: A fix by cross bearings is a quick, reliable and basic position-fixing method in traditional navigation and is regarded as the reference for all other fixing techniques.

Full Load Arrival (Tam Yüklü Varış) duru.en: The Full Load Arrival condition is the scenario in which the ship, carrying the same cargo, reaches the port of arrival after consuming fuel, fresh water and stores during the passage. In this condition the fuel tanks are usually down to the 10% reserve. Fuel consumption can change the position of the ship's centre of gravity considerably; depending on where the fuel tanks are, KG may rise or fall. The arrival condition must therefore meet the stability criteria in its own right.

Full Load Departure (Tam Yüklü Kalkış) d.en: The Full Load Departure condition is the scenario in which the ship leaves port at maximum cargo capacity with 100% fuel and fresh water and all stores fully loaded. It usually corresponds to the highest displacement and, because the VCG (vertical centre of gravity) potential is highest, it is a critical scenario for stability. In the full load departure condition the draft and trim must not exceed the load line limits, and all IMO stability criteria must be met.

Gemi 045°T’nin güvenli tarafında kaldığı.en: The ship is safe as long as she stays on the safe side of 045°T

Gemi bu hattın güvenli tarafında kalır.en: The ship stays on the safe side of this line

Gemi, bu tabana karşı θ açısını görür.en: From the ship, this baseline subtends the angle θ

Gemi, pruvasını rüzgâra çevirse bile yan.en: Leeway occurs even if the ship heads into the wind

Geminin Course ve Distance’ı hesaplanır.en: The ship's Course and Distance are calculated

Göksel kürede gözlemcinin bulunduğu nokt.en: On the celestial sphere the observer's position is taken as the centre, the point directly overhead as the zenith and the point opposite as the nadir. The intersection of the plane tangent at the observer with the sphere forms the horizon. The points where the Earth's axis of rotation meets the sphere are the celestial poles, and the intersection of the plane of the equator with the sphere is the celestial equator.

Göz yüksekliği, objenin tabanı deniz sev.en: The height of eye is subtracted if the base of the object is at sea level

Greenwich meridyeni sabit referans kabul.en: The Greenwich meridian is taken as the fixed reference. The position of a celestial body is expressed by its Greenwich Hour Angle (GHA), and its position relative to the observer's meridian by the Local Hour Angle (LHA). The angular difference between the two meridians is the longitude.

Greenwich zamanı ile yerel zaman arasınd.en: The difference between Greenwich time and local time changes the position of the celestial body. This difference is used both in finding longitude and as an input to the Hc and azimuth calculations. In this way the chain time difference → angular difference → change of position is clearly established.

Güneş gözlemi yapılırken sextant dik tut.en: When observing the Sun the sextant is held vertical. The index arm is moved until the Sun's lower limb touches the horizon. As the ship rises and falls in the swell, the moments of contact are watched several times and an average point of contact is chosen. When the measurement is complete, Hs = 46° 12.4′ is read from the sextant and the time of the observation is taken from the chronometer at the same moment. This value is not yet a position; the use of the sextant ends here. Everything done after this is the correction and interpretation of this measurement. If the sextant is not used correctly, the result will not be reliable however carefully the calculations are done.

Güneş’in deklinasyonu (δ) ve zenit uzakl.en: The Sun's declination (δ) and its zenith distance are interpreted together. The Sun crosses the meridian either north or south of the observer; this decides the sign rule, and the latitude is obtained directly.

Güneş’in yükselip alçaldığı yay izlenir;.en: The arc along which the Sun rises and falls is watched; local noon is the moment of greatest altitude. This moment is found not from the clock but as the point at which the altitude reaches its maximum. Longitude is not needed at this stage.

Günlük İzleme kapsamında, 12 veya 24 saa.en: In daily monitoring, all tanks are sounded at 12- or 24-hour intervals, the fuel reports are updated, the stability calculation is renewed on the loading computer and the noon report data are prepared. A daily stability update allows the ship's safety condition to be monitored continuously throughout the passage.

GZ eğrisi, geminin pozitif stabilite men.en: The GZ curve gives clear information about the ship's range of positive stability and its stability reserve. These two concepts express the safety margin the ship has left against capsizing, especially at large angles.

Harita düzeltmeleri, basılı bir deniz ha.en: Chart correction is the manual entry on a printed chart of changes in the marine environment that have occurred since the chart was published. A chart starts to become out of date the moment it is printed, because the maritime infrastructure is not fixed. Buoys are moved, the characters of lights are changed, new wrecks are found, depths are resurveyed and some areas are legally restricted or released. The chart does not reflect these changes by itself. An uncorrected chart is therefore not valid for navigation even if correct courses and calculations are laid off on it.

Harita düzeltmeleri, resmî olarak yayıml.en: Charts are corrected using the officially published Notices to Mariners. These notices state clearly which chart is affected, the type of change, its geographical position and how it is to be shown on the chart. Every correction is numbered and dated. For a chart to be valid, all corrections up to the latest published Notice to Mariners must have been entered on it.

Harita ölçeği, deniz haritasının neyi ay.en: Chart scale is the basic structure that determines what a chart shows in detail and what it deliberately leaves out. In navigation, scale is not only a mathematical ratio; it is a practical filter that decides which information is sufficient for making decisions, which is deliberately left out, and which chart is to be used at which stage. The same route looks different on charts of different scales, because a chart reinterprets reality according to its scale. Scale therefore answers the question “which decision is this chart right for?” before the question “how accurate is this chart?”.

Harita ölçeği, tek başına seyri güvenli.en: Chart scale alone does not make navigation safe, but choosing the wrong scale makes even correct calculations dangerous. If Mariner's Book dealt with this subject only by defining “large and small scale”, the user might try to manage a port approach with a coastal chart, or assume that a danger not shown on a small-scale chart does not exist. Scale should therefore be presented not as a definition but as a reflex that teaches which chart to make decisions with at which stage. Once this reflex is in place, the chart becomes an active navigation tool rather than a passive drawing.

Harita ölçeğinin en kritik etkisi, genel.en: The most critical effect of chart scale is on generalisation. Small-scale charts deliberately simplify detail so that they can show a large area. Small rocks, extensions of shoals, the limits of narrow channels or secondary aids to navigation may not be shown at all on these charts, or may be shown reduced to a symbol. This is not a deficiency of the chart but a direct result of its scale. On large-scale charts the same area is shown in a much smaller frame, so the depth contours are closer together, there are more soundings, and lines of buoys and the limits of prohibited areas become clear.

Haritada kullanılacak kerteriz True (T).en: The bearing used on the chart must be True (T)

Hat aşılmaz, sadece taraf kontrolü yapıl.en: The line is not crossed; only the side of it the ship is on is checked

Her kerteriz bir LOP (Line of Position).en: Each bearing gives an LOP (Line of Position)

Her kerteriz için geri kerteriz hesaplan.en: The reciprocal bearing is worked out for each bearing

Hesaplama Adımları şu sırayla gerçekleşt.en: The calculation steps are carried out in the following order:

Ho ile Hc farkı doğrusal mesafeye dönüşt.en: The difference between Ho and Hc is converted into a linear distance. The difference found in minutes is read directly as nautical miles. At this stage there is no directional information; only “how much” the offset is has been determined.

Ho, Hc’den büyükse gözlemci varsayılan m.en: If Ho is greater than Hc, the observer is closer to the celestial body than the assumed position is, and the intercept is laid off towards the body. If Ho is less than Hc, the observer is farther from the body and the intercept is laid off away from it.

Horizontal Angle Fix, klasik seyrüseferd.en: The horizontal angle fix is a position-fixing method based on angle geometry that gives very precise results when applied correctly, and it plays an important role in terrestrial navigation where the sextant is in active use.

Inverse Problem of Mean Latitude Sailing.en: The inverse problem of mean latitude sailing gives the course and distance between two known positions and is one of the basic calculation methods of mean latitude sailing in the planning stage.

İki kerteriz arası Advance hesaplanır.en: The advance between the two bearings is calculated

İkinci kerteriz için BB₂ çizilir → LOP₂.en: BB₂ is drawn for the second bearing → LOP₂

İlk gök cismi gözleminden elde edilen LO.en: The LOP obtained from the first celestial observation is drawn as a straight line on the chart. This line means that at the time of the observation the ship was somewhere on it. A single LOP, however, does not give a position by itself.

İlk kerteriz için BB₁ çizilir → LOP₁.en: BB₁ is drawn for the first bearing → LOP₁

İlk LOP, geminin seyri ve mesafesi kadar.en: The first LOP is transferred by the ship's course and distance run

İstenen CMG ve gemi sürati bilinir.en: The required CMG and the ship's speed are known

Kaldırma kuvvetinin büyüklüğü, geminin ş.en: The magnitude of the buoyant force does not depend on the shape or material of the ship but only on the volume of water displaced and the density of the water. This relationship is expressed by Archimedes' principle and forms the mathematical basis of ship stability. The principle is defined as follows:

Kaldırma kuvvetinin etkidiği nokta, kald.en: The point at which the buoyant force acts is called the centre of buoyancy. It is the geometric centre of the underwater volume, and the buoyant force always acts vertically upwards through it. When the ship heels or trims, the shape of the underwater volume changes, so the position of the centre of buoyancy changes too. This movement is the basic mechanism of ship stability.

Kalıcı düzeltmeler, uzun süreli veya kal.en: Permanent corrections cover long-term or permanent changes. Adding a new buoy, changing the position or character of a light, or adding a new wreck to the chart belong to this group. These corrections are entered permanently on the chart and are not erased.

Kalite Kontrol Prosedürü olarak, hesapla.en: As a quality control procedure, the calculated results must be checked for logic. For example, if loading 500 tonnes gives a change in draft of only a few centimetres, is this consistent with the TPC? If GM is very different from what was expected, what is the reason? Simple logical checks like these are very effective in catching large errors.

Kargo Planlama fonksiyonu, konteyner gem.en: The cargo planning function covers bay plan optimisation on container ships, the hold loading plan on general cargo ships and weight distribution analysis on all ship types.

Kerteriz gemiden objeye alınır; haritada.en: The bearing is taken from the ship to the object; the reciprocal bearing is used to draw the LOP on the chart.

Kerteriz, gemiden objeye doğru ölçülür..en: The bearing is measured from the ship towards the object. To draw the LOP on the chart:

Kerterizler aynı anda alınmalıdır.en: The bearings must be taken at the same time

Kerterizler farklı zamanlarda ölçülür.en: The bearings are measured at different times

Kritik Olaylarda Acil Değerlendirme gere.en: Critical events call for an immediate assessment. Deteriorating weather (increasing wind force or wave height), a suspected cargo shift (a sudden change of heel, asymmetric rolling), tank leakage (an unexpected change of level, a trim anomaly) or any abnormal behaviour must trigger an immediate stability assessment.

Kuru Dökme Kargolar arasında tahıl (buğd.en: Dry bulk cargoes include grain (wheat, maize, barley, rice), ores (iron ore, copper concentrate, bauxite), coal, cement, sugar and salt. What these cargoes have in common is that they can shift as the ship rolls. The angle at which a bulk cargo shifts depends on its particle size, moisture content, density and stowage method.

Küçük bir üçgen oluşursa → ortalama merk.en: If a small triangle (cocked hat) is formed → its centre is taken as the fix

Küresel geometri yerine düzlem geometri.en: Plane geometry is used instead of spherical geometry

Küresel üçgen, kenarları büyük daire yay.en: A spherical triangle is a figure whose sides are arcs of great circles and whose corners lie on the surface of the sphere. The basic spherical triangle used in navigation is formed by the North Pole, the departure position and the arrival position. In this triangle the sides are expressed by the co-latitudes and the difference of longitude; the angles are quantities directly related to navigation, such as the initial and final great circle courses.

LCG LCB’nin gerisinde ise: Gemi kıça tri.en: If the LCG is abaft the LCB: the ship trims by the stern.

LCG LCB’nin önünde ise: Gemi başa trim y.en: If the LCG is forward of the LCB: the ship trims by the head.

Leeway ve akıntı ayrı ayrı değerlendiril.en: Leeway and current are assessed separately.

Leeway, klasik seyrüseferde küçük açı gi.en: Although leeway may look like a small angle, it can lead to large position errors on long passages and must always be allowed for in course and position work.

LOP, objeden gemiye doğru çizilir.en: The LOP is drawn from the object towards the ship

LOP’lar keskin açıyla kesişmelidir.en: The LOPs must cross at a well-defined angle, not a shallow one

LOP’lar mümkün olduğunca dik kesişmelidi.en: The LOPs should cross as nearly at right angles as possible

LOP₁, 090°T yönünde 6 NM taşınır.en: LOP₁ is transferred 6 NM in the direction 090°T

LOP₁, Course doğrultusunda A kadar taşın.en: LOP₁ is transferred by A along the course → Transferred LOP₁

Maden cevherleri taşımacılığında en cidd.en: The most serious risk in carrying ores is liquefaction. Granular cargoes whose moisture content is above a certain threshold can start to behave like a liquid under the ship's vibration and motion. This happens suddenly and turns the cargo into a flowing mass like a liquid cargo; a dramatic free surface effect appears and the ship can capsize within minutes. This is why the IMO introduced the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML): the moisture content of the cargo must not exceed the TML.

Mean Latitude Sailing, basitliği ve hızı.en: Mean latitude sailing is widely used in traditional navigation because it is simple and quick; but if it is used without knowing its latitude and distance limits, it can lead to serious position errors.

Thanks to its simplicity and speed, mean latitude sailing is one of the cornerstones of traditional navigation; but using it without knowing its limits of validity can lead to serious course errors, especially in high latitudes and over long distances.

Mean Latitude Sailing, kısa ve orta mesa.en: Mean latitude sailing is suitable for short and medium distances.

Mean Latitude Sailing’de boylam farkı, p.en: In mean latitude sailing the difference of longitude is converted into the actual distance along the parallel.

Mean Latitude Sailing’in doğrudan proble.en: The direct problem of mean latitude sailing, finding a new position from course and distance, is one of the basic calculations of traditional navigation and gives a practical and quick solution, especially on passages in middle latitudes.

Mercator projeksiyon, deniz haritalarınd.en: The Mercator projection is the mathematical projection used for nautical charts and forms the basis of navigational calculations. It is preferred at sea not for aesthetics or geographical accuracy but for navigational accuracy. The Mercator projection preserves direction and bearing relationships, so the course, bearing, distance and position work done at sea can be carried out directly and consistently on the chart.

Mercator projeksiyonda mesafe ölçümü, ya.en: On the Mercator projection distance is measured only on the latitude scale. The mathematical reason is that the projection deliberately stretches the scale in the direction of latitude. This stretching makes the latitude scale a reliable reference for distance.

Mercator projeksiyonda sabit bir hakiki.en: On the Mercator projection the track of a ship steering a constant true course is shown as a straight line on the chart. This line is called a loxodrome. This is why courses can be drawn, measured and followed directly on Mercator charts.

Mercator projeksiyonun en ayırt edici öz.en: The most distinctive feature of the Mercator projection is that the meridians are drawn parallel and equally spaced, while the parallels of latitude are drawn further apart as latitude increases. Near the equator the parallels are close together; towards the poles the distance between them increases. This is a deliberate distortion and the mathematical result of the projection.

Mercator projeksiyonunda enlemler arası.en: On the Mercator projection the spreading of the parallels of latitude is expressed by the isometric latitude. This conversion is the basic quantity of rhumb line calculations:

Mercator projeksiyonunun bu avantajı, al.en: This advantage of the Mercator projection is gained at the cost of distortions of area and distance that grow rapidly with latitude. Distances measured on a Mercator chart therefore do not give the true distance directly; they must be read only from the latitude scale.

Merkez açı d derece cinsinden bulunduğun.en: Once the central angle d has been found in degrees, its value in nautical miles can be calculated directly:

Mesafe, D.Lat ve Departure bileşenlerine.en: The distance is resolved into D.Lat and Departure components

Nötr denge ise geminin küçük bir yatma s.en: Neutral equilibrium is the special case in which the ship, after a small inclination, tends to stay in her new position. In this state there is neither a righting nor a capsizing moment. The ship stays at whatever angle she is left. It is possible in theory, but in practical ship operation it is undesirable and rarely met.

Obje merkezli yarıçap = D daire yayı.en: Arc of a circle centred on the object with radius = D

Obje’den 225°T doğrultusunda LOP₁ çizili.en: LOP₁ is drawn from the object in the direction 225°T

Obje’den 270°T doğrultusunda LOP₂ çizili.en: LOP₂ is drawn from the object in the direction 270°T

Objeler arası yatay açı ölçülür.en: The horizontal angle between the objects is measured

Objeler arasındaki yatay açı (Horizontal.en: The horizontal angle between the objects is measured

Objeler aynı doğrultuda hizalandığında t.en: A transit is formed when the objects are in line

Objelere olan mesafe, üçgen geometrisi i.en: The distances to the objects are calculated by triangle geometry

Objelerin eş zamanlı kerterizleri alınır.en: Simultaneous bearings of the objects are taken

Onay ve Belgeleme aşamasında, kaptan sta.en: In the Approval and Documentation stage, the master reviews and approves the stability calculations. The stability calculation sheet is signed and filed. The loading plan is recorded. These documents are legally valid for PSC inspections and any casualty investigation.

Operasyonel Değerlendirme aşamasında, be.en: In the Operational Assessment stage, the expected weather, the length of the voyage and particular conditions on the route (narrow waters, shallow water) are taken into account. If heavy weather is expected, increasing the GM margin and minimising the free surface effect are considered.

Orta enlem seyri, düzlem seyirin geometr.en: Mean latitude sailing does not abandon the geometry of plane sailing completely; it only corrects the longitude component using the mean latitude. This gives a more accurate result over short and medium distances without the need for complex projections.

Orta enlem seyrinde, seyir boyunca değiş.en: In mean latitude sailing the latitude, which changes during the passage, is represented by a single value. This value is the arithmetic mean of the departure and arrival latitudes. When the change of longitude is calculated, the length of a minute of longitude is taken for this mean latitude.

Ortalama enlem, başlangıç ve varış enlem.en: The mean latitude is defined as the arithmetic mean of the departure and arrival latitudes. It represents the latitude of the ship over the passage with a single value. In the mean latitude sailing approach, east–west distances are assessed according to the length of a minute of longitude in this latitude.

Ölçülen açı, gemi mevkiinden görülür.en: The measured angle is seen from the ship's position

Önce merkez açı d hesaplanır:.en: First the central angle d is calculated:

Paraleller arası mesafe sabit varsayılır.en: The distance between the parallels is assumed to be constant

Periyodik Gereksinimler kapsamında, yükl.en: As periodic requirements, the loading computer is verified annually, re-approved at 5-year intervals, and after any modification of the ship (change to a hold, added superstructure, tank modification etc.) a software update and re-approval are mandatory.

Raporlama kapsamında, şirket DPA (Design.en: For reporting, the company DPA (Designated Person Ashore) is informed, the classification society and the flag State are notified and, if necessary, SAR (Search and Rescue) coordination is started. All actions are recorded with their times and results.

Rhumb line (loxodrom), küre üzerindeki t.en: A rhumb line (loxodrome) is a curve that cuts all meridians on the sphere at a constant angle and gives a constant course throughout the passage. Its appearance as a straight line on the Mercator projection makes practical navigation much easier.

Rhumb line, küre üzerinde meridyenleri s.en: A rhumb line is a curve that cuts the meridians on the sphere at a constant angle. Because the Mercator projection preserves angles, this curve appears on the chart exactly as a straight line. This lets the navigator draw the track of a ship steering a constant course on the chart with a ruler in one stroke.

Rota ve mesafe, bir dik seyir üçgeni olu.en: The course and distance form a right-angled sailing triangle

Running fix, açık denizde pratik ve işle.en: A running fix is practical and useful in the open sea; but if there is a change of course or speed, or if DR discipline is weak, the result is not considered reliable. The method should therefore be used, where possible, to supplement fixes from simultaneous LOPs, not to replace them.

Running fix, göksel seyirde aynı anda el.en: In celestial navigation a running fix is based on bringing position lines (LOPs) that cannot be obtained at the same time to a common time, allowing for the ship's movement. Observations made at different times are combined at a single time to obtain a fix. It is a practical solution when few celestial bodies are available or when the weather does not allow simultaneous observations.

Running Fix, klasik seyrüseferde tek obj.en: The running fix is one of the basic terrestrial fixing methods in traditional navigation; it allows a position to be found from a single object and gives high accuracy when time and the ship's movement are applied correctly.

Running Fix, klasik seyrüseferde zaman v.en: The running fix is one of the basic position-fixing methods in traditional navigation; it brings time and movement into the solution and is highly reliable when applied correctly.

Rüzgâr iskele tarafından geldiği için ge.en: Because the wind is coming from the port side, the ship drifts to starboard.

Rüzgâr iskele tarafından geliyorsa → gem.en: If the wind comes from the port side → the ship drifts to starboard

Rüzgâr sancak tarafından geliyorsa → gem.en: If the wind comes from the starboard side → the ship drifts to port

Rüzgâr, gemiyi yanal olarak sürükler.en: The wind pushes the ship sideways

Saat 08:20’de elde edilen LOP, geminin s.en: The LOP obtained at 08:20 is transferred parallel to itself 6 nautical miles in the direction of the ship's track. Its intersection with the second LOP, obtained at 08:50, is the ship's running fix at 08:50.

Serbest yüzey etkisinin en kritik sonucu.en: The most critical result of the free surface effect is that it reduces the ship's effective GM. This reduction makes the ship behave as though her centre of gravity had risen.

Set yönünde D₍c₎ kadar gidilir.en: D₍c₎ is laid off in the direction of the set

Sextant ile ölçülen en büyük yükseklik,.en: The greatest altitude measured with the sextant is converted to Ho (observed altitude) by applying all the corrections (IE, dip, refraction, SD, parallax). In the noon position Ho represents the true altitude of the Sun on the meridian.

Sextanttan okunan alet yüksekliği Hs = 2.en: Let the sextant altitude read from the sextant be Hs = 27° 18.4′, with an index error of −1.6′, a height of eye of 16 m and a lower-limb observation of the Sun.

Seyir orta enlemlerde yapılır.en: The passage is made in middle latitudes

Seyir üçgeni hâlâ dik üçgen kabul edilir.en: The sailing triangle is still taken to be a right-angled triangle

Sonuç Kontrolü aşamasında, hesaplanan de.en: In the Results Check stage, the calculated values are compared with the IMO criteria and the ship's approved limiting curves. The parameters to be checked are:

Stabilite Kaybı Belirtileri ve bunlara k.en: The signs of loss of stability and the immediate actions against them can be summarised as follows:

Şamandıra düzeltmeleri, seyir güvenliğin.en: Buoy corrections are the chart corrections that affect navigational safety most directly. If a buoy is moved, removed or re-established, the symbol on the chart is cancelled completely and the new position is entered with the correct symbol. If the light character, colour or type of the buoy has changed, all the related descriptive information is updated together with the symbol.

t₁ anına ait LOP, geminin seyir doğrultu.en: The LOP for time t₁ is transferred parallel to itself along the ship's track by the distance run. This does not change the direction of the LOP; it only moves its position to time t₂.

Tank Yönetimi fonksiyonu, tüm tankların.en: The tank management function contains the capacity tables of all tanks, the sounding/ullage conversions and the free surface moments. As the contents of the tanks are entered, the software automatically calculates the weight, VCG, LCG and FSM values.

Taşınan LOP ile ikinci LOP’un kesişimi F.en: The intersection of the transferred LOP and the second LOP gives the fix

Taşınan LOP, orijinal LOP’a paralel kalı.en: The transferred LOP stays parallel to the original LOP.

Tehlike ile gemi arasında minimum mesafe.en: A minimum distance is kept between the danger and the ship

Tehlikeye teğet geçer.en: It passes tangentially to the danger

Tehlikeyi emniyetle teğet geçen bir doğr.en: A line that passes the danger safely at a tangent is chosen

Transfer Operasyonları seyir sırasında s.en: Transfer operations affect stability directly during the passage. When transferring fuel, port–starboard symmetry must be kept, the change in GM monitored and the number of slack tanks kept to a minimum. In ballast operations, trim optimisation, GM correction and the IMO Ballast Water Management (BWM) requirements must be assessed together. Especially during ballast exchange at sea, because the sequential method empties and refills the tanks one by one, the stability must be checked for every intermediate condition.

Transit (Leading Line), klasik seyirde e.en: A transit (leading line) is one of the most reliable and simplest position-fixing methods in traditional navigation and is indispensable especially in areas where navigational safety is critical.

Uyarı İşaretleri aşamasında stabilite ka.en: In the Warning Signs stage, the signs that a loss of stability has started must be recognised. A marked lengthening of the rolling period indicates that GM has decreased. A tendency of the ship to lean to one side from upright (a loll) shows that GM is approaching zero or has become negative. A steadily increasing angle of heel, with the ship unable to return upright by herself, indicates that a critical loss of stability has begun.

Üç LOP idealde tek noktada kesişir.en: Ideally three LOPs cross at a single point

Üçgen hem grafik, hem sayısal çözülebili.en: The triangle can be solved both graphically and numerically

Vardiya Bazında İzleme kapsamında, her v.en: In watch-by-watch monitoring, the fuel consumption is followed every watch, changes in tank levels are checked, the ship's draft and trim are observed and her rolling characteristics are assessed. A lengthening of the rolling period is an important sign that GM is decreasing and must be investigated at once.

Varsayılan mevki (AP), DR mevkiine yakın.en: The assumed position (AP) is a point close to the DR position and is the reference point for which Hc and Zn are calculated. The weighed or calculated gross mass of every container must be documented before loading. Containers without VGM information must not be loaded on board. The requirement was introduced to prevent stability casualties like those caused in the past by misdeclared weights.

If a least depth is given for a wreck, this value is shown clearly on the chart and used directly in draft calculations.

When tank data are entered, the density and temperature values are checked. The weights and positions of the cargo are specified. Separate calculations are made for both the departure and the arrival conditions, because fuel consumption during the passage can change stability considerably.

Yükleme bilgisayarının temel fonksiyonla.en: The basic functions of the loading computer fall under four main headings. Under stability calculation, the software calculates the draft, trim and heel, determines KG and GM, produces the GZ curve and checks all the IMO stability criteria automatically. If any criterion is not met, it gives an alarm or warning.

Yüzerlik şartını sağlayan bir gemi, kuvv.en: A ship that satisfies the condition of flotation is in equilibrium as far as forces are concerned; but this equilibrium alone does not explain how the ship behaves under a small external disturbance. The essence of ship stability is how the ship responds when she is displaced from her position of equilibrium. This response is described by the states of equilibrium and is studied in three basic classes: stable, unstable and neutral equilibrium.

Cb veya squall hattı yaklaşırken tedbirl.en: When a Cb or squall line approaches, the precautions are driven by the wind, not the rain, because the first blow arrives with the gust front. Radar is used actively to detect the precipitation cells and to work out their movement vector (the cells give bright, high-intensity echoes). Personnel on deck are brought inside, derricks/cranes are secured and open hatch covers are closed. Assuming the wind will suddenly shift and strengthen, the ship's position relative to the wind is assessed; at anchor, the engine is kept ready because of the risk of dragging the anchor. Because of the lightning risk, work on antennas and other high points on the open deck is stopped. Small cells can be avoided with visual and radar tracking without departing from the route; an organised squall line is crossed at its weakest point, at right angles if possible.

Demirde köprüüstü nöbeti sürdürülür; mev.en: A bridge watch is maintained at anchor; the position, the swinging circle, the weather and other ships are monitored. If there is a risk of dragging, the engine is kept on stand-by. Adequate scope, a suitable bottom (sand/mud holds well; rock holds poorly) and a sound watch are the basis of safe anchoring.

Demirin tutması büyük ölçüde zincirin de.en: The holding of the anchor depends largely on the chain applying a HORIZONTAL pull along the seabed. The length of chain paid out (scope) must therefore be several times the depth of water. In good weather the usual rule is chain of about 5–6 times the depth; more (7+ times) is paid out in bad weather. The weight of the chain (catenary) keeps the pull horizontal and increases the holding power.

Demirin tutmayıp sürüklenmesi (dragging).en: Dragging of the anchor is monitored by: taking a bearing of a fixed object/landmark and watching for change (transit/clearing bearing), the GPS anchor watch alarm, depth changes on the echo sounder, and sudden tension and vibration in the chain. If dragging is detected, more scope is paid out or action is taken with the engine or by re-anchoring.

Demirleme (anchoring), gemiyi belirli bi.en: Anchoring transfers the load of the ship to the seabed through the anchor and chain to hold her safely in a given position. The right choice of position, adequate scope (chain paid out) and good holding ground keep the ship from dragging. Maintenance of the anchoring equipment and manoeuvring discipline are critical for both safety and operational reliability.

Demirleme yerinde su derinliği 40 m ise.en: If the depth of water at the anchorage is 40 m, approximately how much scope should be paid out in good weather?

Demirli gemi sürekli izlenir; tarama tes.en: The anchored ship is monitored continuously; if dragging is detected the engine is made ready and the scope is increased.

Demirli gemi sürekli izlenir: GPS demirl.en: The anchored ship is monitored continuously: her position is checked with the GPS anchor alarm, bearings/ranges (transits, radar ranges) and visual references. Signs of dragging: the chain constantly taut or vibrating, the ship moving relative to her references, the anchor alarm sounding. If dragging is detected the engine is made ready and, if necessary, the scope is increased, the second anchor is let go, or the ship re-anchors or gets under way. When heavy weather is expected, the scope is increased in advance and the engine is kept on stand-by.

İstenen kalomaya ulaşınca band freni sık.en: When the required scope is reached, the band brake is applied and the stopper is put on

The second anchor is let go under control; letting it go at high speed overloads the chain and the windlass.

Tarama belirtisinde önce makine hazır ed.en: At the first sign of dragging the engine is made ready and the Master is called; the ship must be ready to manoeuvre at any moment. Waiting increases the risk of grounding or collision, and heaving up unprepared is risky in darkness and in traffic.

Zincirde ritmik sarsıntı, kerteriz değiş.en: Rhythmic jerking of the chain, a change of bearing and a shift in position are signs of dragging; the engine is made ready and the scope is increased or the ship shifts berth.

Tüm değerler metre cinsinden; sonuç ≥ mi.en: All values in metres; the result must be at least the minimum UKC required by the UKC policy

MHoT = tidal window’u açan minimum gelgi.en: MHoT = minimum height of tide that opens the tidal window

Pozitif fark: sancak leeway (sancağa kay.en: Positive difference: leeway to starboard; negative difference: leeway to port

Tehdit: dış risk faktörleri (hava, trafi.en: Threat: external risk factors (weather, traffic, equipment failure) | Error: deviation in human performance | Outcome: preventing an undesired (unsafe) state

Paris MOU concentrated inspection kampan.en: Paris MoU concentrated inspection campaigns focus on a specific item of equipment or procedure; the current campaign topic should be checked before the voyage

Bearing = pusula yönü (°); CPA → 0'a yak.en: Bearing = compass bearing of the target (°); if CPA approaches 0 the risk is critical; TCPA = time (min); taking early action while TCPA is still above 15–20 min is standard practice

Give-way gemisi: diğerini sancağında gör.en: Give-way vessel: has the other vessel on her own starboard side | Stand-on vessel: has the other vessel on her port side — keeps her course and speed under Rule 17

22.5° kıç-omuz hattı, yan fenerlerin (he.en: The line 22.5° abaft the beam is where the sidelights (112.5° each) end and only the sternlight (135°) is visible; a vessel approaching from abaft this line is overtaking and must always keep out of the way

Rradar = kullanılan radar menzili (nm);.en: Rradar = radar range in use (nm); Tstop = time to stop (min); in practice the ship's stopping distance should not exceed half the radar range in use

Reason'ın İsviçre Peyniri Modeli: her sa.en: Reason's Swiss cheese model: every layer of defence (procedures, equipment, training, supervision) has holes; an accident happens when the holes line up

Her ihlal için: kural maddesi — yükümlül.en: For each breach: rule reference — content of the obligation — how it was breached — contributing factors; multiple layers of breaches are analysed

E (doğu) hatalar +, W (batı) hatalar − a.en: Easterly (E) errors are +, westerly (W) errors −. True = Compass ± compass error.

Süre gidiş-dönüş olduğu için ikiye bölün.en: The time is for the round trip, so it is halved. The speed of sound in seawater is about 1500 m/s.

Zincirin dibe yatay çekme uygulaması tut.en: Holding comes from the chain lying on the bottom so that the pull on the anchor is horizontal; the smaller the angle, the better the holding.

Daire içine sığlık, diğer gemiler ve eng.en: No shoal, other ship or obstruction may lie within the swinging circle.

Yağmur, deniz spreyi, sis ve fumigation.en: Rain, sea spray, fog and fumigation conditions are checked separately.

Vektör yalnızca aynı zaman damgasına ait.en: The vector is drawn only between a DR position and a fix for the same time.

Gerçek risk değerlendirmesi gelgit, cate.en: A real risk assessment also takes into account the tide, the chain catenary and the geometry of neighbouring ships.

Salınan zincir boyunun su derinliğine ti.en: Typical ratio of the length of chain paid out to the depth of water (varies with the holding ground and conditions)

STCW asgari dinlenme süresi; en fazla 2.en: STCW minimum hours of rest; in no more than 2 periods, one of them at least 6 hours uninterrupted

Sığ suda gemi draftındaki artış hızın ka.en: In shallow water the increase in draft (squat) grows with the square of the speed; reducing speed reduces squat
